metadata.title: DFC Objective Specifications
metadata.purpose: Define Desired Future Conditions as objective specifications separate from CKAN reference data and SVO Adapter transform logic.
notes: DFC target records are reference data and should be loaded from CKAN when published.
Transform specs remain in the SVO Adapter registry.
Objective specs describe what should be evaluated; the planner decides how to evaluate it.

selection_fields.gma_id: Groundwater Management Area label or number, for example GMA 12.
selection_fields.aquifer: Aquifer or aquifer-system selector used to match adopted DFC target records.
selection_fields.metric: DFC metric selector, for example drawdown, saturated_thickness_or_storage, spring_flow, or stream_flow.
selection_fields.target_year: Target year for the DFC comparison when present in the adopted target records.
selection_fields.areas: Optional list of area names to restrict evaluation; omit or use empty list for all matching DFC target areas.

target_fields.targets_uri: URI of the adopted DFC target dataset, preferably a CKAN resource URI once published.
target_fields.record_selector: Fields used to select DFC records from the target dataset.
target_fields.record_id_field: Field name for stable target record identifiers.
target_fields.value_field: Field name containing target values and units.

source_requirement_fields.standard_variable_uri: SVO variable needed by the planner.
source_requirement_fields.unit: Preferred or required unit for the comparison.
source_requirement_fields.format_preferences: Ordered source data formats preferred for this objective.
source_requirement_fields.source_profile: Optional source-selection profile, such as ntgam-v301.
source_requirement_fields.allow_user_override: Whether a caller may provide a specific source_data_object_id.

evaluation_fields.comparison_scope: Whether evaluation is per target area, GMA-wide, or another objective-defined scope.
evaluation_fields.boundary_strategy: How target-area boundaries should be resolved.
evaluation_fields.compliance_rule: Operator and interpretation for comparing modeled values to target values.
evaluation_fields.no_fake_outputs: Must remain true for scientific decision-support objectives.

boundary_strategy.strict_scope_goal: Eventually aggregate over GMA intersection target-area boundaries when fused boundary intersection is available.
